incident.failure: Yahoo Finance CNH=X chart request returned no timestamp or close observations for the frozen window; v4 model, holdout metrics and SGX probe were not executed in that run.

substitution_scope: data source only; preserve the pre-registered economic question, closure-extra transform, frozen model, train/holdout windows and progression gates

new_data_contract.provider: Hong Kong Monetary Authority public API

interpretation_correction: HKMA publishes a Hong Kong daily RMB reference against HKD. The USD/CNY cross derived from the same HKMA daily table is a Hong-Kong-market China-FX price-discovery proxy. It must not be labeled as an exact executable interbank CNH spot series without separate source proof.
time_boundary: unchanged: only observation dates strictly earlier than the target China trading date are eligible; closure_extra is cumulative return between China information boundaries minus the final daily return and must be zero with zero or one new observed interval
selection_gate: unchanged from parent preregistration: candidate must improve full-holdout IC and SSE versus v3 and improve SSE on the multiple-external-interval mechanism subset
